positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
- Learned the 2-sided AdTech marketplace and competitive landscape to help identify new areas of opportunity.
- Collected and analyzed data from various big data sources using SQL and Python to identify key insights.
- Wrote clear and concise product requirements that captured the vision, goals, and key elements of new products and features. 
- Iterated on a feature to improve aspects of privacy-preserving advertising. 
- Modeled a proof of concept to kickstart a feature pilot.
- Partnered across teams at Apple to communicate and launch products.
- Crafted a presentation for Apple executives.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Project Management · Product Management · Data Analysis · SQL · Hive

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Rebuilt the filtering feature from the UI/UX and product decisions to the implementation
- Built new features in Javascript on the frontend of the app using the ionic/angular framework 
- Remodeled and debugged corresponding backend functionalities in Python
- Conducted and organized market research from related apps to create UI mockups in Figma
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · JavaScript · Product Management · Graphic User Interface (GUI) Design · Software Development

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
- Created a recommendation deck for how Stellar Pizza could launch a new customer loyalty program
- Conducted user research and market research to compare various options that would best align with the company's values
- Implemented feedback from the team periodically, and finally, presented the recommendation to the CEO
positions.insights: Skills: Public Speaking · Product Management · User-centered Design · Market Research · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Innovator
positions.description:
- Worked with LEGO and the UN as a consultant to craft recommendation decks for their described problem
- Trained mindset through practical philosophy discussions with mentors and employing them during technical hackathon sprints
- Presented research slide decks, potential product ideas, and recommendation decks to judges, peers, and mentors
- Started blogging on Medium and sharing my research on the Internet of Things
positions.insights: Skills: Internet of Things (IoT) · Consulting · Public Speaking · Blogging · Entrepreneurship
